name: io.github.walidboulanouar/business-ai-agents
title: Business AI Agents
description: Compare business agent platforms by workflow, permission model and trial criteria.

tools.name: search_firms
tools.description: Find business agent platforms and partners by name, specialty or workflow. Omit the query for the full directory. Results include IDs for compare_firms and links to sources.

tools.name: compare_firms
tools.description: Compare two to five business agent platforms and partners by their directory IDs from search_firms. Returns profiles, source links and procurement questions.

tools.name: recommend_providers
tools.description: Read the editorial picks for business agent platforms and partners, each with a specific use case and supporting source. Use short project keywords, or omit the query to review all picks.
